title: Improper Neutralization of Input During Web Page Generation ('Cross-site Scripting') vulnerability in Brainstorm Force…
description: A stored cross-site scripting (XSS) vulnerability exists in Brainstorm Force SureDash versions up to 1.12.3. This flaw allows improper neutralization of input during web page generation, potentially enabling an attacker with limited privileges to execute malicious scripts in the context of other users. The vulnerability has a CVSS 3.1 base score of 6.5, indicating a medium severity level.
